Fixes #29344

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `git grep` for `features.sso` and `auth/config` under `skills/` finds 0 files; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` already tells readers that `/auth/config` serves `features.sso` when SSO is configured, which stays true; the API reference page is regenerated in this diff

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 的 `GET /api/v1/auth/config` 响应契约 `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` 新增可选布尔键 `sso`（服务端早就在发、登录页早就在读，只是契约没声明）。
- 为什么改：按契约解析响应的客户端会把这个键静默丢掉，看不到「用 SSO 登录」入口；声明后与服务端实发一致。
- 风险与回滚：纯加宽，以前能解析的响应原样解析；没有默认值，不发就仍是不存在；运行时代码一行未动；回滚即撤掉此 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`（新键与说明）、`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`（新测试）、`.changeset/29344-auth-config-features-sso.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`，预期 31 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：确认新公开键名 `sso`（PR 上挂 needs-user-decision）；其余席位落地。

## What changes

- **`AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.sso`** (`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`), an optional boolean beside `ssoEnforced`, no default. Its describe says what the producer means: true when enterprise SSO is *usable* (the domain-routed SSO plugin is wired AND at least one SSO provider is configured), false when SSO is off or on with no provider yet, absent means not usable. It names which producer value is served (the `isSsoUsable` answer, not the coarse wired flag, falling open to the wired flag when providers cannot be counted) and how it differs from `ssoEnforced` (that one takes the password form away; this one only says whether the SSO entry exists). The tracker id sits in an adjacent `//` comment only.
- Regenerated: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (`api/AuthFeaturesConfig:sso`, written by the build) and `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx` (`gen:docs`, the one artifact `check:generated` named stale). The same set the `features.cloudManaged` precedent (#25292, PR #25309) touched on the spec side.
- Changeset `.changeset/29344-auth-config-features-sso.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, both declaration lines.

**Producer readings** (origin/main `96fb7b5d`):

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` `getPublicConfig()` sets `sso: this.isSsoWired()` (the coarse "plugin wired" flag).
- Both HTTP doors that answer `GET /auth/config` refine it to `isSsoUsable()` before answering: plugin-auth's `/config` route (`auth-plugin.ts`, `if (config.features?.sso) config.features.sso = await isSsoUsable()`) and the hono adapter's auth route (`packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`, same refinement). `git grep getPublicConfig` over `packages/` finds no third door. So a client always sees the usable answer; the unrefined value is read only inside the server (the boot sign-in reachability check, `auth-plugin.ts`), which no client sees. No producer disagreement a client can observe, so no `domain:server` finding.

**Classification:** `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.sso` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) is `surface: 'login'`, `opt-in`, exempt with the reason "the served value is refined to usable via isSsoUsable()": it agrees with the new describe. No pin ties the registry's keys to `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema`'s keys (the plugin-auth drift guard ties the registry to the served booleans, not to the schema), so nothing there moved. See Acceptance notes.

**No liveness row.** `packages/spec/liveness/` governs metadata types; no ledger names this API response (`git grep AuthFeaturesConfig packages/spec/liveness` finds nothing), the same as for `cloudManaged`.

**No forced test edits.** No existing test was changed.

## Why

`GET /api/v1/auth/config` serves `features.sso` and the console's login form reads it (`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`, `config?.features?.sso === true`, through a hand-typed `sso?: boolean` in `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts`), as does the mobile shell per the card. The contract did not declare it, so a client parsing through `GetAuthConfigResponseSchema` dropped it silently.

One correction to the card's premise text: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts`'s `body.features.sso === true` reads `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` (the plan-entitlement flag the cloud-connection `RuntimeConfigPlugin` passes through), a different response. The premise still holds through the LoginForm reader above.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`, new block `AuthFeaturesConfig.sso (served, now declared)`, 8 cases:

- a served `sso: true` and `sso: false` parse and are kept;
- the whole `GetAuthConfigResponseSchema` parse keeps `features.sso` beside `ssoEnforced`;
- CONTROL: an absent `sso` stays absent (no default is invented);
- a non-boolean `sso` (`"yes"`, `1`, `null`) is refused with exactly one `invalid_type` issue at path `sso`, expected `boolean`;
- the describe names `isSsoUsable` and `ssoEnforced` and carries no tracker id.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same-class drift, larger than this card.** `getPublicConfig().features` serves at least nine more keys `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` does not declare: `multiOrgEnabled`, `tenancyPosture`, `audiencePosture`, `degradedTenancy`, `oidcProvider`, `deviceAuthorization`, `admin`, `termsUrl`, `privacyUrl` (most are classified in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` or `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS`, and several have readers, e.g. `deviceAuthorization` in the console's device-auth page). A contract parse strips them all. No pin ties the registry to the schema keys. Reported to the seat as one family card, not filed here.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts` keeps a hand-written mirror of the features type (its `sso` comment says "wired", while the served value is "usable"). Not touched; noted.

See the readings above. The PR stays a draft; the seat runs the contract review, and the new public key name `sso` goes to the maintainer as `needs-user-decision`.
